title: Front Street Taproom
venue_description:
About Front Street Taproom

Front Street Taproom stands as downtown Fargo's premier craft beer destination with 30 taps featuring locally brewed beer from Minnesota and North Dakota. Located on historic Main Avenue the taproom offers a warm atmosphere with rustic wooden decor and comfortable seating across two levels.

Music and Entertainment

Monday nights feature open mic hosted by Travis Neros from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM welcoming all forms of creative expression including music readings comedy and poetry. Sign-up begins at 7:30 PM. The venue also hosts trivia nights vinyl listening parties and live music on weekends.

The Cellar Comedy Venue

Below the taproom lies The Cellar an underground comedy club bringing professional touring comedians to Fargo. This intimate 100-person capacity space hosts regular comedy shows creating an authentic comedy club atmosphere rarely found in North Dakota.

Amenities

While the taproom does not have a kitchen guests can order delivery from neighboring Rhombus Guys pizza. The venue offers two spaces for private rentals: the Mezzanine (up to 35 people) and The Cellar (up to 100 people). The taproom opens daily at 4:00 PM with happy hour specials.

title: Troll Lounge at Sons of Norway
venue_description:
About the Troll Lounge

The Troll Lounge is one of Fargo's most distinctive music venues located inside the Sons of Norway Kringen Lodge. This unique bar features hand-carved wooden trolls and Norwegian murals creating an unforgettable cultural atmosphere.

Music Programming

Tuesday evenings from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM host bluegrass jam sessions where musicians bring instruments and join in collaborative picking. Monthly Thursday evenings feature Amped Open Mic hosted by Amped School of Music starting at 7:30 PM. Professional backline equipment including keyboards drums guitars and ukuleles are available on stage.

Cultural Experience

As part of Sons of Norway the venue celebrates Norwegian heritage while welcoming the broader community. The Kringen Kafé serves traditional Scandinavian-American cuisine Tuesday through Friday. Happy hour runs from 4:30 PM to 6:00 PM with drink specials. Popular menu items include the Lefse Crunch Burger and Troll Burger.

Venue Details

This is a 21+ venue with special accommodations for performers under 21. Individuals under 18 must be accompanied by a parent. Adults ages 18-20 are only permitted when performing. The intimate setting provides excellent acoustics for live performances.

title: Hope and Coffee
venue_description:
About Hope and Coffee

Hope and Coffee is Fargo's first nonprofit coffee shop operating under Soul Solutions Recovery Center. All proceeds support helping individuals find recovery and embrace their best life creating a welcoming space for everyone in the community.

Music and Open Mic

Every Saturday evening from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM Hope and Coffee hosts Open Expressions an acoustic open mic night. Sign-up begins at 6:00 PM for this family-friendly event welcoming all forms of creative expression. The event is completely free with professional PA system microphones and cables provided for performers.

Community Mission

The venue provides a safe welcoming environment where those in recovery and the general public merge together. The 1300 square foot space offers free Wi-Fi comfortable seating and quality coffee drinks smoothies and baked goods. Additional events include sober karaoke movie nights and art classes.

Recovery Resources

The Recovery Bookstore inside the shop offers books and support materials related to recovery and personal growth. An attached community center provides additional classes and activities. Open weekdays from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

title: The Aquarium
venue_description:
About The Aquarium

Since opening in 2006 The Aquarium has established itself as North Dakota's premier live music venue. Located above Dempsey's Public House this independently owned venue has hosted more national regional and local artists than any other place in the state with a capacity of 260 people.

Notable Performances

Past performers include Father John Misty Bon Iver Phoebe Bridgers The Melvins Prof Built To Spill Band of Horses Trampled By Turtles Against Me! and Screaming Females demonstrating the venue's ability to attract cutting-edge talent across indie rock folk punk metal hip-hop and electronic music.

Venue Mission and Awards

The Aquarium's mission focuses on bringing original cutting-edge music to Fargo-Moorhead to bolster a more inspired diverse and creative community. Ryan Hoffart and Josie Gereszek serve as co-directors. The venue has earned High Plains Reader's Best Music Venue award multiple years in a row.

Programming

While most shows occur on Friday and Saturday nights The Aquarium hosts events any night of the week. The venue books diverse genres and occasionally hosts all-ages shows providing crucial performance opportunities for younger musicians and fans. Special events include Emo Night Karaoke album release parties and touring packages.
